authenticity_review: Significant AI artifacts reduce authenticity. Primary defect: texture mapping anomaly where checkerboard pattern wraps around organic curves (udders, legs, necks) without distortion—physically impossible for real materials. Secondary defects: hoof-ground fusion (lack of sharp depth discontinuity per geometric_depth_auditor criteria), minor ear blending between adjacent cows, and overly uniform synthetic lighting. The perceptual_quality_auditor reported no graphics-level distortions (noise/compression/blur), confirming these are structural/generative artifacts rather than post-processing issues. Animal_pose_auditor flagged LOW artifact risk (18% low-confidence keypoints in hind limbs/face), consistent with visible anatomical uncertainty in those regions.
key_defects: Count mismatch: 5 cows rendered vs 6 requested
Texture topology violation: checkerboard pattern ignores surface curvature
Grounding failure: hooves merge with grass without sharp contact boundary
Minor fusion: ear boundaries blend between adjacent subjects
